empty.title: What shall we make?
empty.imageText: Describe a picture in your own words. Photos can be attached with the paperclip.
empty.videoText: Describe a video in your own words. A picture can become its first frame.
empty.hint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter starts a new line. Examples fill the input; nothing is sent by itself.
empty.imageExample1: A cozy coffee shop on a rainy evening, warm light, view from the street
empty.imageExample2: A product photo of a white sneaker on a pastel background, soft shadows
empty.imageExample3: A watercolor postcard with a lighthouse and seagulls
empty.videoExample1: A drone flies slowly over a misty pine forest at sunrise
empty.videoExample2: Close-up: coffee is poured into a glass cup, steam rises, slow motion
